_concept: ALGORITHMS — a first-class asset class, not content hidden inside scripts
_one_line: The value of an analysis product IS its algorithms. Everything else — the data, the findings, the documents — is either an input to them or an output of them.

_why_first_class.the_audit: The asset registry declared five kinds — gold_table, store, tool, doc, gold_database — all of them ARTIFACTS. Zero algorithms. The techniques existed only as implicit content inside scripts, which made them invisible: we could not say which algorithm runs where, reuse one deliberately, compare ours against the market's, or improve one and know what it affected.
_why_first_class.the_market_argument: What a buyer pays Celonis or Signavio for is not their storage and not their dashboards — it is conformance checking, variant analysis, object-centric mining. The algorithms ARE the product. Ours being undeclared meant the product was undeclared.
_why_first_class.the_sharper_argument: An algorithm fails differently from a tool. A broken tool fails loudly. A subtly wrong algorithm produces confident, plausible, WRONG output. This session produced four: a greedy classifier rule that stole FTBB from bank statements; a substring matcher that linked 337 claims to 'CO'; a wrong denominator that made a 35% gap of which half was a category error; a swallowed generic error that masked an invalid field for three runs. You cannot review what you have not named.
_why_first_class.the_portability_argument: A tool is one binding of an algorithm to one problem, one schema, one tenant. The ALGORITHM is what travels to installation #2. Data ages, findings age, tools are bindings — algorithms compound.

_fields.operates_on: the data class it consumes — logs / process events / repository / data / model / interfaces
_fields.origin: MARKET_STANDARD (adopted) · MARKET_EXTENDED (adopted and improved) · OURS (no market equivalent)
_fields.bound_in: the tool(s) that implement it — an algorithm with no binding is a paper
_fields.failure_mode: how this algorithm produces a WRONG answer without failing loudly
_fields.lands_in: the STORE where this algorithm's findings become durable. An algorithm that only prints is a leak by construction — discovery without landing is loss. Enforced by brain_v2/methods/unlanded_discoveries.py (rebuild Step 0i).

A3_two_axis_classification.does: explain every call on two independent axes — PROCESS (from the object name) and ORIGIN (from host/destination/user)
A3_two_axis_classification.why_extended: process mining assigns activities but does not systematically resolve WHO CALLED. Without origin, a middleware call and an internal report are indistinguishable.
A3_two_axis_classification.produced: the 80.6%-external finding; 91.1% of business calls explained
A3_two_axis_classification.failure_mode: an unresolved origin collapses a fleet into one label — 174 middleware endpoints currently read as one caller
A3_two_axis_classification.improve: resolve endpoint GUIDs from the middleware side; SAP cannot name them
A3_two_axis_classification.gated: GATED s097: 10 golden cases over classify_origin/classify. The ORIGIN axis is what the cases protect — MULESOFT, BRIDGE-RFC and SMTMSBP must never read as people, and OUR OWN extraction must be excluded or we measure ourselves as the business.
A3_two_axis_classification.lands_in: Zagentexecution/sap_data_extraction/sqlite/job_classification.json (dataset) -> brain_v2/claims/claims.json - a call stream nobody explains is noise; the PROCESS/ORIGIN split becomes a claim about who really drives a domain

A4_ordered_classifier_ladder.does: ordered rule chain (package -> software component -> overlay -> name -> text -> substrate); first match wins, specificity expressed by ORDER
A4_ordered_classifier_ladder.failure_mode: ORDER-DEPENDENCE IS SILENT. A greedy early rule steals from a later one and nothing errors. Proven twice in s097: 'FTB' swallowed FTBB (bank statements) into deal management; an inline comment swallowed two dict entries and moved 70,766 executions between domains.
A4_ordered_classifier_ladder.improve: replace the package-regex rung with the DF14L component lookup, which is authoritative. Regex becomes the fallback, not the primary. THIS IS PRIORITY 2 OF THE WHOLE MODEL.

A5_adaptive_learning_loop.does: auto-resolve unknown calls by function group / naming / app domain, LEARN the resolution, re-classify until convergence, expose the remainder as an explicit frontier
A5_adaptive_learning_loop.why_it_matters: the closest thing the model has to learning — each run explains more with zero hand-coding
A5_adaptive_learning_loop.failure_mode: a rule learned WRONG persists forever and invisibly — DEMONSTRATED on its first run with the new signal: mapping the broad technical bucket Basis_Security to one business process taught it that IDOCS_OUTPUT_TO_R3, IDOC_INBOUND_ASYNCHRONOUS and BAPI_EXCHANGERATE_GETDETAIL are identity management. 7 rules purged; the mapping removed so it cannot be relearned. Returning NOTHING is correct for a technical call: it goes to the frontier for human review, which is where it belongs. Precision beats coverage when the engine remembers its mistakes.
A5_adaptive_learning_loop.improve: give it the reads/writes signal (C3) so it can resolve custom FMs that have no curated overlay entry
A5_adaptive_learning_loop.fed_by: C1/C1b/C1c component resolution — the authoritative rung, s097
A5_adaptive_learning_loop.result_s097: 8 -> 25 learned rules, +17 ALL from the authoritative signal, zero hand-coding. Coverage 92.7%. Frontier 224 FMs / 225,568 calls (7.3%), mostly kernel FMs not in TFDIR at all.
A5_adaptive_learning_loop.lands_in: process_mining/learned_rules.json (dataset) -> brain_v2/methods/unlanded_discoveries.py - the UNRESOLVED remainder is the point. Convergence hides what it could not explain unless the remainder is surfaced

F1_interface_boundary_analysis.does: enumerate the boundary (RFCDES / EDIDC / TBTCP / ICFSERVICE) and CORRELATE the configuration against observed traffic in the call stream. Configuration says what someone once set up; the call stream says what happens today; the GAP is the finding, in both directions.
F1_interface_boundary_analysis.why_it_matters: the boundary carries 1.33M executions and 37 documented flows, and the map is PROSE written by hand: it cannot detect a new destination appearing, cannot go stale visibly, and cannot be reproduced on a second installation (INSTANCE, not KIT)
F1_interface_boundary_analysis.improve: disambiguate the remaining truncated fragments by CALL SIGNATURE rather than by prefix: if a fragment calls the same function modules as exactly one full name, it is that name.
F1_interface_boundary_analysis.first_run: 238 destinations configured -> 10 LIVE, 228 DEAD (configured, zero traffic: maintenance and attack surface nobody uses), 249 UNDECLARED (traffic with no RFCDES entry). 9 IDoc message types / 19,400 documents. 5,822 active HTTP services. FULL scan, no sampling.
F1_interface_boundary_analysis.failure_mode:
TRUNCATION: PARAMX is a FIXED-LENGTH field and SAP cuts the caller string when it does not fit — 'caller: host=HQ-SAP-P01_P01_00, dest=HQ-SAP-P01-1_P01_'. I had recorded this as 'the parse truncates names', which was WRONG ABOUT THE CAUSE: the regex extracts exactly what is stored, and no better pattern can recover a character the source never wrote. FIXED by reconciliation instead of parsing (caller_parse.py): a value that is a strict PREFIX of exactly one longer observed value is the same entity cut short. 81 repaired; 72 left AMBIGUOUS on purpose, because a fragment with two completions would be an invented fact. REMAINING: 'HQ-SAP-P0' carries 2.6M calls and is ambiguous — too many candidates share that prefix.

SOURCE APPLICABILITY (s106, claim 620) -- distinto del de truncacion y peor, porque no producia un dato feo sino un VEREDICTO creible. La correlacion se hace contra rsau_audit_history.PARAMX, que registra llamadas RFC. Un destino de tipo G/H (HTTP) lo mueve cl_http_client, que NO es RFC y no escribe fila ahi. Resultado: 40 destinos publicados como DEAD -- 'superficie de mantenimiento y ataque que nadie usa' -- sobre evidencia que no podia verlos. Entre ellos svc-prod-role.hq.int.unesco.org, el servicio RoleManagement, que su proyecto dueno documenta como dependencia viva de produccion. LO QUE LO HIZO INVISIBLE: el propio comentario del script declaraba 'DEAD is now a fact rather than an artefact' tras quitar el muestreo de 400.000 filas. Cierto y enganoso a la vez -- quitar el muestreo arregla la COBERTURA de la fuente, no su APLICABILIDAD, y son propiedades distintas. Un instrumento que mejora su cobertura se siente autorizado a afirmar mas, cuando puede seguir siendo ciego al caso. ARREGLADO: tabla OBSERVABILITY por RFCTYPE; cubo `unobservable` aparte (40) frente a `dead` (187); campo `observability` en cada fila; `caveat` en los tipos L/X, cuyo transporte no esta confirmado; `_evidence_base` declarado en la salida; y `boundary_unobservable` anadido a build_brain_state.py para que los 40 se RECOLOQUEN en vez de caerse del brain. REGLA GENERALIZABLE: antes de que un algoritmo emita un veredicto sobre una poblacion, tiene que declarar que su fuente CUBRE a cada individuo de esa poblacion. Si no lo cubre, el veredicto correcto es NO PUEDO VER, y va en su propio cubo -- nunca en el cubo negativo.
F1_interface_boundary_analysis.lands_in: brain_v2/interface_boundary.json (dataset) -> brain_v2/claims/claims.json - configuration that exists and never fires, and traffic with no configuration behind it, are both claims about the operating model
F1_interface_boundary_analysis.also_populated_by: A23_channel_discovery_by_traffic — F1 correlaciona la CONFIGURACION contra el trafico; A23 descubre canales que no tienen configuracion ninguna. Son complementarios: F1 encuentra lo declarado que no corre, A23 lo que corre sin declarar

F2_satellite_derivation.does: group boundary endpoints into SATELLITES by call signature, resolve what each calls, and bind it to the domains and flows it drives
F2_satellite_derivation.why_it_matters: each interface DEFINES a satellite; the satellite is the ORIGIN of the transaction; the origin is what associates it to a flow. In a system orchestrated 80% from outside, the satellite catalogue IS the process map at the boundary.
F2_satellite_derivation.first_run: 40 satellites from 7,783,106 calls; 12 GUID FLEETS RECOVERED. Independently rediscovered MuleSoft: a 21-endpoint fleet calling Y_BAPI_WBS_FINANCIAL_DATA_1 974,868 times -> PS -> PROJ2FUND, and a 17-endpoint fleet on Y_BAPI_YPS8 -> PS/PSM_FM -> B2C2A, P2P, POST2BUDGET, PROJ2FUND.
F2_satellite_derivation.failure_mode: endpoint names arrive TRUNCATED from SAP (PARAMX is fixed length), which split one satellite across several labels. FIXED in s097 via caller_parse: fleets recomposed from 17/21 endpoints to 7/6 once the truncated GUIDs merged with their full forms. What remains is the ambiguous tail — fragments with more than one possible completion are deliberately NOT merged, because a wrong merge invents a satellite.
F2_satellite_derivation.improve: fix the truncation, then merge fleets whose endpoint prefixes match | after A5 learned 17 rules the 19-endpoint fleet resolved from ? to FI (drives B2C2A, DISBURSE, O2C_BILLING) — evidence that re-running the cycle after a lower layer improves is not ceremony.
F2_satellite_derivation.lands_in: brain_v2/satellites.json + brain_v2/process_flows/process_flows.json (dataset) -> brain_v2/claims/claims.json - which satellite drives which domain

A7_concept_drift.does: monthly activity profile per domain as RATES PER DAY (executions, distinct objects, distinct users); a month is flagged when at least TWO signals depart from the trailing baseline by more than 50%. One signal moving is noise; two is a change of shape.
A7_concept_drift.why_it_matters: replaces the threshold heuristics in check_triggers with a question put to the log itself: did the process change, and when? A biennium organisation has an EXPECTED drift at the boundary; any other drift is the finding worth having.
A7_concept_drift.failure_mode: TWO defects found on its own first runs, both worth recording because both produce confident nonsense: (1) comparing monthly VOLUMES across unequal months produced 11 signals, almost all in the first FULL month — the window is 2026-02-21..2026-06-21, so February has 3 days and April 30. Fixed by normalising per day. (2) z-scores over a two-month baseline exploded to z=1016 because the standard deviation collapses. Fixed by using relative change, which is robust at n=2 and readable. An absurd number dressed as a statistic is worse than a plain one.
A7_concept_drift.current_reading: 3 signals, ALL in 2026-06, all 'distinct objects up', across UNRELATED domains (CTS_Transport, HCM, Basis_Security). Same month + same signal + unrelated domains is the signature of a CAPTURE CHANGE, not process drift. Recorded as a SUSPICION, not a finding.
A7_concept_drift.improve: needs about a year of history before a z-score is meaningful and before an expected biennium boundary can be told apart from an anomaly. It strengthens purely by the accumulator continuing to run — which is the argument for protecting A2. | PERFORMANCE: ~7 minutes per run because it scans all 15.6M audit rows with no index. It should aggregate per month INCREMENTALLY into a small table and read that. A slow algorithm gets skipped, and a skipped algorithm is documentation.
A7_concept_drift.lands_in: brain_v2/drift_signals.json + brain_v2/drift_profile.json (dataset) -> brain_v2/claims/claims.json - a flagged month is not knowledge until it carries its explanation

C4_object_role_derivation.does: derive what each object is FOR — posting engine, report, interface, worklist, master-data maintenance, checker, batch engine, technical — from signals we already hold: edges, execution channel, audience size, volume and text
C4_object_role_derivation.why_it_matters: the model could say where an object BELONGS and not what it DOES. 'PBC has 33 objects' is not knowledge; '2 posting engines, 14 reports, one operator on the worklist' is. A domain with readers and no writer is CONSUMED, not operated — and no list of names can say that.
C4_object_role_derivation.first_run: 178 objects: 55 REPORT, 46 POSTING_ENGINE, 27 MASTER_DATA_MAINTENANCE, 23 INTERFACE, 12 WORKLIST, 9 CHECKER, 4 TECHNICAL, 2 BATCH_ENGINE. INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION of the operating model: PS, Travel, BusinessPartner, Procurement_P2P and Treasury_EBS all flagged DRIVEN FROM OUTSIDE — derived from object ROLES, not from the audit log's origin axis. Two independent methods agreeing is real validation.
C4_object_role_derivation.failure_mode: a role is a HYPOTHESIS. A report that writes a log table looks like a writer; a getter that posts looks like a reader. The confidence and the evidence are returned so a reader can disagree — a role asserted without its evidence would be worse than none.
C4_object_role_derivation.improve: feed it the flows: an object's role WITHIN a flow (approver, poster, reconciler) is sharper than its role in general
C4_object_role_derivation.lands_in: n/a - technique: it shapes how data is read, it does not produce findings. Classified from its own `does` text, s099.

D6_aggregate_before_resolve.does: push the row reduction into SQL (GROUP BY), then resolve the expensive enrichment ONCE per distinct entity, and cache the aggregate against a watermark so a re-run with no new data costs nothing
D6_aggregate_before_resolve.why_it_matters: MEASURED 548x less Python work: 15,605,644 audit rows collapse to 33,607 (month,object) pairs over 26,131 distinct objects. 430s -> 187s cold -> 30s warm. And speed is not an optimisation here: a slow algorithm gets skipped, and a skipped algorithm is documentation — the model stops learning without anyone deciding it should. AND IT IS NOT ONLY SPEED: in interface_boundary the pattern made a full scan affordable, which removed a 400,000-row sample that had been producing WRONG verdicts — two destinations reported DEAD that are alive, and 209 undeclared callers hidden. A sample presented as a census is how a model lies quietly.

A8_change_to_executor_attribution.does: join a STATE-CHANGE stream to an EXECUTION stream on (user, day, hour) to derive WHAT WRITES a thing and through WHICH CHANNEL CHAIN. Scored by the phi coefficient over the slot contingency table, with an exclusivity constraint across classes. The channel is not a label but a CHAIN with evidence per link — DIALOG, RFC_INBOUND (naming the calling host/destination from PARAMX, which is the satellite), FILE (naming the paths), BATCH_JOB (naming the job that fires the program), PROGRAM — and every derived channel is cross-checked against the DECLARED taxonomy in integration_channels.json, kept in a separate field, with a verdict: CONFIRMED / UNCONFIRMED PROSE / UNDECLARED.
A8_change_to_executor_attribution.why_it_matters: It converts a change log into behaviour. The model could say a thing changed and who the user was; it could not say what did the writing — and for the largest object class in this tenant, 93% of the change documents carry NO transaction code, so the field that should answer is empty. This is the generic enrichment: any state-change log crossed with any execution log answers the same question. Which program sends this IDoc type. Which job produces this file. Which process touches this interface. It is not a PBC analysis that happened to work; it is the method.
A8_change_to_executor_attribution.first_run: 72 object classes, 3,280 programs, 2,493 hour-slots. Recovers known-correct writers as a control: RM_MEPO_GUI for EINKBELEG (purchase orders), RM_MEREQ_GUI for BANF (requisitions), the HR engine chain RHHCP_DC_EMPLOYEE / RHRFPM_ENGINE_PA30 for PBC and FMRESERV. SAPMSSY1 correctly demoted to AMBIGUOUS everywhere.
A8_change_to_executor_attribution.failure_mode: THREE SCORINGS WERE WRONG BEFORE ONE WAS RIGHT, and each failure is now a comment in the file. (1) RAW COINCIDENCE named a spool artifact as the writer of the largest class, because the RFC dispatcher runs constantly and coincides with everything. (2) LIFT fixed that and inverted the error: it rewards RARITY, so it ranked the real PBC engine below noise and filtered it out — HUNCALC0 runs on 91 of 108 days, so its base rate is 0.84 and its lift cannot exceed 1.19 however perfect the coincidence. An engine is not rare; running whenever the class changes is what makes it the engine. (3) Small denominators: a program that ran ONE day scored lift 27 on a single coincidence — the same defect as D6's z-score over a two-month baseline, in different clothes. The standing failure mode is that CO-OCCURRENCE IS NOT CAUSATION. Two programs in the same chain cannot be separated below the shared time granularity. Every row carries its evidence and a verdict so a human can disagree. FOURTH AND FIFTH FAILURES, both found on its own output: the channel was decided by whether a dispatcher reached the TOP of a ranking built to DEMOTE dispatchers — suppressing the signal and then looking for it where it had just been suppressed, so 71 of 72 classes came back as anything-but-interface. And the cross-check APPENDED the declared channel beside the derived ones, which silently promotes a sentence in a markdown table to the standing of a measurement and destroys the very comparison that makes either side worth having. Five wrong designs before one that holds.
A8_change_to_executor_attribution.improve: (a) the exclusivity constraint is a FLAG, not a solver — a real global assignment would sharpen every row at once; (b) join on the object key where the execution log carries one; (c) feed the named function modules straight into F1/F2 so a satellite inherits the tables it writes; (d) DBCON and WEBSERVICE are declared in the taxonomy but have no derivation yet — there is no DBCON table in the golden and ICF only says a service is active, not that it wrote.
A8_change_to_executor_attribution.gated: GATED s097: golden cases over phi() and the channel classifier, including the two scorings that were wrong — a daily dispatcher must score 0, and a program that covers nearly every change slot must NOT be filtered for being frequent.
A8_change_to_executor_attribution.lands_in: brain_v2/change_attribution.json (dataset) -> brain_v2/claims/claims.json + brain_v2/annotations/annotations.json - WHAT WRITES a thing, and through which channel, is an object-level fact

P1_profile_composition.does: compose the installation profile from 18 COMPONENTS, each bound to the algorithm that derives it, each carrying its own provenance — DERIVED, DECLARED or MISSING
P1_profile_composition.why_it_matters: the profile was HAND-MAINTAINED. profile_concept.json said so itself: 'who_updates: any session that measures something — EDIT unesco_system_profile.json'. A hand-edited profile cannot be reproduced on a second installation, cannot go stale visibly, and cannot say what it is missing. Composing it turns 'profile this system' from an exercise into a runnable list, and the DERIVED share is the honest portability number: 61% of the profile costs nothing on the next tenant, and the rest is named.
P1_profile_composition.first_run: 18 components — 11 DERIVED, 6 DECLARED, 1 MISSING. The MISSING one is security_posture: nothing in the repository derives it, which is the SAME gap the capability grid reports from the other side (E_AUTH empty in 16 of 21 domains). Two instruments agreeing that something is absent is worth more than a placeholder.
P1_profile_composition.failure_mode: IT COMPOSES, IT DOES NOT MEASURE. A component reads DERIVED because an artifact exists with content — not because that content is CURRENT or CORRECT. A stale artifact from six months ago composes exactly like a fresh one, so P1 must be read together with the cycle state and the drift signal, never alone. It also cannot tell a DECLARED value that is right from one that is wrong; it only says a human put it there.
P1_profile_composition.improve: (a) carry each artifact's mtime so a stale component is visible in P1 itself rather than only in the cycle state; (b) shrink the DECLARED set — every one converted to DERIVED is hand work removed from installation #2, and footprint and org_structure are the two closest, since probe_footprint.py already derives them and only the WRITE-BACK is manual; (c) build the security-posture derivation, the one genuine hole.

A10_address_chain_reconstruction.does: reconstruct the chain from funding source to piece of work in an installation where no foreign key carries it: infer the GRAMMAR of the identifiers, walk each declared HOP, and report per hop whether it resolves, through WHICH carrier, how much finer resolution survives, and whether any instrument can observe it changing
A10_address_chain_reconstruction.fires_on: check_triggers.py — the designed work carrier crossing zero, a NEW identifier grammar appearing, the fund or WBS master growing >=5%, or any chain object having no change-document coverage. Placed in run_analysis_cycle.py after extract_business_rules.py
A10_address_chain_reconstruction.why_it_matters: SUBSTITUTED is the verdict that pays for the algorithm: a link that works through a string convention or a custom table is invisible to anyone reading the data model, so it is never migrated, never documented, and never load-tested — and it is load-bearing
A10_address_chain_reconstruction.failure_mode: scoring a carrier against a population it was never meant to serve, which reads as a broken chain and is a mis-stated denominator; and a discovered change-document class claiming a table on a shared prefix. A11_shared_algorithm_memory.does: hold what each algorithm LEARNED about the substrate — which log is a filtered subset, which connection drops, which declared column is blank in every row — so the next algorithm starts from it instead of rediscovering it or, worse, drawing a conclusion from an instrument it did not know was partial
A11_shared_algorithm_memory.fires_on: continuously — every algorithm calls recall() before choosing its instruments and remember() after establishing a fact. It is not scheduled; it is a dependency
A11_shared_algorithm_memory.why_it_matters: algorithms.json records what each algorithm IS. This records what each one LEARNED. Only the second one compounds — without it every algorithm pays the same discovery cost forever
A11_shared_algorithm_memory.the_rule: a memory carries subject, fact, who learned it, the evidence, and what OTHER algorithms should do differently. A memory with no implication is a note, and notes are not machine-actionable
A11_shared_algorithm_memory.failure_mode: a stale memory is worse than none — the substrate changes. Re-learning the same subject by the same algorithm SUPERSEDES rather than duplicates
A11_shared_algorithm_memory.improve: expire a memory whose evidence is older than the window the claim depends on

A12_set_hierarchy_traversal.does: walk a SAP set hierarchy to every leaf, then answer the three questions that decide whether a roll-up is safe: which master values roll up NOWHERE, which repeat INSIDE one tree, and which appear across SEVERAL root trees. Only then report what each level consumes
A12_set_hierarchy_traversal.fires_on: after any SETS extraction, and whenever an organisational roll-up is to be reported
A12_set_hierarchy_traversal.why_it_matters: nothing in the fact tables references a hierarchy — the roll-up exists only in configuration, so 'what does this sector spend' has no mechanical answer until the sets are traversed. And the answer is unusable until the orphans are counted
A12_set_hierarchy_traversal.failure_mode: three real ones, all found in the first run. Defining a root as 'appears as a parent' drops FLAT sets and reports their whole master as 100% orphaned. Counting every repeated membership as double-counting turns biennium VERSIONING into a fake defect. And identifying a set class by matching leaf values invites numeric collision — class 0303 matched the fund-centre master at 79.3% and is a cost-centre hierarchy
A12_set_hierarchy_traversal.improve: resolve non-numeric leaf RANGES against the master instead of marking them unenumerable

A16_payroll_end_to_end.operates_on: the payroll engine — configuration that reads like data
A16_payroll_end_to_end.does: discover payroll end to end in six parts: the ENGINE (schemas), the LOGIC (rules), the OUTPUT (wage types, grouped by stem), the GATES (features), the MASTER DATA including whether it is maintained by hand or fed, and the POSTING path with the enhancements sitting on it

A16_payroll_end_to_end.the_premise_it_is_built_on: PAYROLL LOGIC IS NAMED AFTER WHAT IT PRODUCES. Searching the schemas and 166,453 rule lines for the budget rate returned one false positive; grouping wage types by stem found it immediately — 72 'Constant Dollar' members under stem 9. A16_payroll_end_to_end.why_it_matters: payroll is neither ABAP nor data, so a code search does not reach it and a table search does not recognise it. It computes the largest spend category in most public-sector installations and was a black box here
the_two_questions_that_are_not_an_invent: is this master data maintained BY HAND or FED? — a change document with a transaction code was made by a person in a screen; a BLANK transaction code is the signature of a BAPI, an interface or a batch, and the ratio is the answer

A17_change_governance.operates_on: the change log crossed with the execution log and the transport record
A17_change_governance.does: detect three governance conditions: a CHANNEL DIFFERENCE where an object is reached by a route its other maintainers do not use, CONFIGURATION changed in production that has never travelled by transport, and a transport channel carrying DATA rather than development
A17_change_governance.fires_on: per close, and whenever a governance or segregation question arises
A17_change_governance.the_premise_that_makes_it_portable: THE POPULATION OF MAINTAINERS DEFINES THE NORM. No policy document is needed and none is asked for — whatever route most people use for an object is the expected route. That is what lets the same detector run on any installation
A17_change_governance.every_finding_carries_its_counter_explan: a channel difference is a SIGNAL, not a verdict. Number ranges are not transported by SAP design; a new implementation is naturally driven from the editor before its transaction is rolled out; role generation legitimately carries its generated tables

two_kinds_of_channel_finding.GENERIC_ROUTE_IS_THE_NORM: the MODAL route for the object IS the editor — the stronger finding, and the one the first version missed because it only looked for outliers

A18_reality_filter.operates_on: any operational table crossed with the record that proves its rows became real
A18_reality_filter.does: measures the distance between what the system RECORDS and what HAPPENED, in both directions: BACKWARD, which recorded rows never became real (simulations, reversals, parked); FORWARD, which configured entries never produce a document (dormant design)
A18_reality_filter.fires_on: BEFORE summing any operational table for a figure that will be reported, and before describing a configured mechanism as THE mechanism
A18_reality_filter.why_it_exists: session 98 made BOTH errors on the same subject in the same day. The staff budget-rate impact was measured at USD 20.5 million and is USD 1.98 million — 90% was simulation runs. And 72 configured wage types were described as the mechanism when zero of them post. Both were confident, both were evidenced, both were wrong the same way

the_two_signals.uniform_ratio: a suspiciously EVEN ratio across unrelated groupings means a filter is missing from the query, not that the data is strange. The payroll-to-FI ratio was 10-14% in every company code, document type and month of three years. An incidental gap varies; a systematic one does not
the_two_signals.whole_or_nothing: when a grouping makes the PARTIALS disappear, that grouping is the unit the process actually works in. By document the cut looked like attrition; by RUN it was 488 wholly present, 1,828 wholly absent, zero partial

A18_reality_filter.the_guard_that_makes_it_safe: it refuses to judge outside the window where the EVIDENCE table has coverage. bkpf in the golden starts at 2024; applying the payroll discriminator to 2023 would mark every real run as a simulation. That check is the difference between an algorithm and a habit
A18_reality_filter.what_it_does_not_do: it does not delete. It reports the distance and names the discriminator; purging is a separate deliberate act (scripts/extraction/purge_simulation_runs.py)

relates_to.A13_custom_field_harvest: A13 is the FORWARD direction for FIELDS; A18 generalises it to configured ENTRIES and adds the backward direction

A18_reality_filter.the_distinction_that_saved_a_figure: NEVER_REAL (deleted, reversed, simulated) invalidates a sum of WHAT HAPPENED. NO_LONGER_LIVE (completed, cleared) does NOT — a completed commitment is the most real kind, it became an actual. The first version conflated them, reported FMIOI 95.6% unreal, and would have thrown away A14's correct -2,365,688.44 USD
A18_reality_filter.failure_mode: two, both found by running it. A19_wbs_model.operates_on: a master table's custom extension, measured on three axes at once
A19_wbs_model.does: reads every custom field of a master table on THREE axes — type-aware fill, trend by creation year, and cardinality — and emits the verdict the three produce together: EN ABANDONO, EN ADOPCION, SIN INFORMACION, EN USO, RESIDUAL or VACIO. the_three_axes.fill_type_aware: trim(trim(col),'0.') — a numeric or NUMC field is never blank, it defaults to zero, so one emptiness test for every type is how a dormant field passes as a live one
the_three_axes.trend_by_creation_year: a flat low rate and a decaying one mean OPPOSITE things. Group by the row's creation date or the curve is invisible
the_three_axes.cardinality: a field with one distinct value has a fill rate and no information

A19_wbs_model.the_by_product_worth_having: WHO writes the master, from the creator field by year. The FIRST row a technical user ever wrote IS an integration go-live, dated to the day, from data already held — and a grammar that collapses to one shape DATES the automation, while the variance before it measures what the hand cost

C6_routine_level_behaviour_extraction.does: split a source file into ROUTINES with line ranges and derive, per routine, what it reads and writes, the guards under which it declines to act, the messages it can raise, and a ROLE (VALIDATION / SUBSTITUTION / DERIVATION / HELPER) inferred from what it does with its result rather than from its name. Surfaces the subset that CAN STOP A POSTING — the system's real control surface.
C6_routine_level_behaviour_extraction.failure_mode: silent under-reading. C6_routine_level_behaviour_extraction.improve: parse assignments to routine PARAMETERS, not just to TABLE-FIELD; and resolve member-table reads (READ TABLE mt_x) back to the SELECT that filled them in the constructor, so a buffered config read is attributed to the routine that uses it

C7_brain_informed_code_interpretation.does: read code THROUGH the brain and write back what it learned. Resolves every identifier in a routine against claims, incidents, annotations and the gold table registry — preferring records that DECLARE the object over ones that merely mention it — then states in UNESCO terms what the routine decides and under which conditions. Scores understanding as explained/found identifiers, names each unexplained one as a task, flags claims whose asserted SAP objects are absent from the code, and returns CONTROL_POINT annotations to the brain for every routine that can stop a posting. The loop is bidirectional: the brain explains the code, the code corrects the brain.
C7_brain_informed_code_interpretation.failure_mode: confident nonsense from a weak match. Resolving on prose mention alone matched a routine's own local variable (LV_BANKS) to a claim that merely quoted the routine, and the conflict detector fired on ordinary English written in capitals until it was anchored to the known object universe. A wrong 'meaning' reads exactly like a right one, so every resolution must carry its source.

A43_fsv_alignment_check.metodo_INTERPRETAR: Las 8 tablas no valen lo mismo ni fallan igual. T011/T011T = el MARCO (que versiones existen): coincidieron desde el primer dia, y que coincidan NO dice nada del contenido — el marco coincide y el contenido no. FAGL_011PC = jerarquia de posiciones, con clave SUBROGADA (ID por contador) y PARENT/CHILD/NEXTN apuntando a ella: por eso la unidad de alineamiento es la VERSION ENTERA, no la fila. FAGL_011QT = textos de posicion. FAGL_011ZC = la asignacion cuenta->posicion y la unica que responde a la pregunta de negocio: el intervalo vive en VONKT-BISKT, asi que UNA CUENTA NO ESTA MAPEADA SI NO EXISTE LA FILA DEL INTERVALO — la ausencia no se ve mirando la cuenta, se ve mirando el intervalo (P01 tenia "1.1.1.1 -> 4041015-4041019"; D01 llegaba a 4041013 y V01 a 4041014). FAGL_011SC = sets, la unica donde "DIFIEREN" domino sobre "faltan" (229 D01 / 213 V01). TRES CLASES DE RESULTADO por tabla, con consecuencia distinta: faltan (esta en P01 y no en destino => CREAR), difieren (misma clave, valor distinto => MODIFICAR, exige humano), solo-en-destino (version vieja o basura local: ni se propone borrar ni rompe el exit code). Y las VERSIONES no son intercambiables: FS10 la ejecuta UNES, FS11 es de IIEP/ICTP y KONS/INT son demos de SAP de 1995 (claim 554); quien decide cual aplica es el parametro BILAVERS de la variante de RFBILA00, NO T011 — y este script no lo mira, asi que por defecto suma deriva de versiones que nadie ejecuta.
A43_fsv_alignment_check.metodo_AGRUPAR: Por SISTEMA DESTINO x TABLA x clase de resultado (faltan / difieren / solo alli), nunca por cuenta: la pregunta es "que canal no llego", no "que cuenta falta". En el unico detalle que baja al negocio — FAGL_011ZC — agrupa los intervalos ausentes POR VERSION (Counter sobre VERSN) y luego los lista como ERGSL + VONKT->BISKT con tope 60, porque el trabajo se acota por version viva y no por cuenta (runsheet: "si FS11 no esta viva, el trabajo se reduce a la mitad"). `--accounts <prefijo>` filtra ese detalle por familia de cuenta (p.ej. 40410, la del ticket de Treasury). A40_config_transport_prerelease_check.metodo_LEER: 1) En el ORIGEN: E070 por TRKORR (existe / funcion / estado / quien / cuando) y E07T (texto). 2) E071K WHERE TRKORR -> pares OBJNAME/TABKEY agrupados por tabla; si sale vacio imprime "no lleva claves" y TERMINA. 3) Por tabla, DD03L WHERE TABNAME -> campos ordenados por POSITION con KEYFLAG y LENG, descartando los que empiezan por "." (.INCLUDE). LIMITE CONOCIDO Y YA PAGADO: hay que usar LENG (longitud en CARACTERES), nunca INTLEN (interna Unicode, 2 bytes/caracter) — la 1a version troceo con INTLEN, MANDT(3) se comio 6 posiciones, ninguna clave caso y el check informo OK estando roto (retro s101 §2.2). 4) La tabla ENTERA con todos sus campos en ORIGEN, cierra conexion, abre DESTINO, la tabla entera otra vez. read_table NO hace .strip() a proposito ("los blancos son datos, no ruido"), aunque key_of/value_of si hacen rstrip despues, de modo que una diferencia de blanco FINAL se compara como igual — defendible porque un CHAR no puede almacenar un blanco final (regla feedback_a_char_field_cannot_store_a_trailing_blank); un blanco INTERIOR si se ve.
A40_config_transport_prerelease_check.metodo_INTERPRETAR: E071K.TABKEY es un CAMPO DE ANCHO FIJO: MANDT + los campos clave concatenados por LENG, sin separador — "350ID   USTRD O01" se trocea en (350, ID, USTRD, O, 01). Trocearlo es la operacion critica y su autocomprobacion forma parte del metodo: si NINGUNA clave del transporte existe en origen ni en destino, eso no es un transporte raro, es el troceo roto -> aborta con exit 2 en vez de decir OK. E070.TRSTATUS: D = modificable (el check protege) / R = liberado (ya no protege nada, solo avisa). TRFUNCTION: W/K = ORDEN padre, Q/S/T = TAREA — y las claves viven en la TAREA. LA MECANICA QUE HAY QUE SABER PARA LEER LA SALIDA: un transporte de tabla guarda la CLAVE y exporta el VALOR AL LIBERAR, no al capturarlo; de ahi que el diff correcto sea valor-origen vs valor-destino HOY, que restaurar el valor neutralice el dano aunque la clave siga dentro, y que la entidad vecina quede ACOPLADA al transporte hasta la liberacion (cualquier edicion suya viaja sola y en silencio). "Entidad" = 1er campo clave tras MANDT (LAND1 en YTFI_*, LZBKZ en T015L, KTOPL en T030H), overridable con --entity-field; la mayoritaria del transporte es lo que estabas manteniendo.
A40_config_transport_prerelease_check.metodo_AGRUPAR: No por tabla ni por clave: por DOS EJES cruzados — pertenencia al transporte (dentro/fuera) x igualdad del valor entre sistemas — mas un tercer eje de PROPIEDAD (entidad mayoritaria vs ajena), que es el que convierte un diff en un hallazgo. Cuatro clases, cada una con una accion distinta: [VIAJA] dentro + distinto -> es tu cambio, verifica que TODO es intencionado. [INTRUSA] dentro + entidad ajena -> la clase de Indonesia, hace FALLAR el check (exit 1), quitala por SE10. [NO-OP] dentro + igual -> no cambia nada al importar, candidata a quitar de la lista de objetos. [DERIVA] FUERA + distinto -> divergencia real entre sistemas que esta orden no corrige. El agrupador es un collections.Counter sobre el campo entidad de las claves del transporte; main_ents = las que empatan en el maximo.

(2) SUBCLASS **no significa lo mismo en todas las clases**: en 0312 es el área FM (UNES, IBE, ICTP…) — por eso el scope por área funciona; en 0303 son dígitos ('1','4','6') y el mismo filtro devolvería vacío. A60_outbound_channel_availability.operates_on: los destinos RFC salientes tipo G/H del Gold DB (rfcdes) + una peticion HTTP real por destino
A60_outbound_channel_availability.does: contestar la pregunta que ningun inventario nuestro contestaba: DE LOS 239 DESTINOS SALIENTES, ¿CUALES RESPONDEN AHORA MISMO? Parsea RFCOPTIONS (H host, I puerto, N path, s SSL, D usuario, Q auth), hace UNA peticion SIN CREDENCIALES por destino y clasifica la FORMA del fallo, que es el dato: 401/403 = ARRIBA y pide auth (el servicio corre, si algo falla es la credencial) · 404 = puerto arriba, aplicacion no desplegada en esa ruta · 5xx = arriba y rota · CONNECTION_REFUSED = el host vive y NADA escucha en ese puerto (instancia parada) · TIMEOUT = ruta bloqueada o destino saturado · DNS_FAIL = el nombre no resuelve.
A60_outbound_channel_availability.failure_mode: CONFUNDIR DISPONIBILIDAD CON USO, en los dos sentidos. 'Arriba' NO significa 'se usa': un destino vivo y sin trafico es indistinguible aqui de uno vivo y muy usado -- el trafico de un saliente se mide en el OTRO extremo. Y 'caido' NO significa 'incidente': muchos destinos estan configurados y nunca se usaron. Ademas: (a) un 200 en el endpoint de configuracion NO garantiza que la aplicacion funcione -- ADS puede responder y aun asi fallar un render; (b) mide desde la maquina que lo corre, NO desde P01, y una ruta puede existir para el servidor y no para el portatil (cuando el veredicto importe, contrastar con SM59); (c) no cubre destinos tipo 3 (ABAP) ni T (programa externo), que se prueban con RFC_PING. NUNCA enviar credenciales: un 401 es el RESULTADO que se busca, no un fallo que reintentar autenticado.
A60_outbound_channel_availability.improve: programarlo (tarea recurrente) y guardar historico para tener una SERIE de disponibilidad por destino, que es lo que convierte una foto en un monitor. Anadir tipo 3/T por RFC_PING.
A60_outbound_channel_availability.lands_in: n/a - instrumento: contesta en PANTALLA (o --json), no produce artefacto persistente todavia
A60_outbound_channel_availability._nace_de: INC-000016471 (2026-08-26): el canal por el que sale TODO PDF de la casa estuvo caido TRES DIAS LABORABLES sin que nadie lo supiera. Estaba etiquetado NO_MEDIBLE -- cierto del TRAFICO, falso de la DISPONIBILIDAD -- y ademas DEAD en interface_boundary, veredicto que venia de contar llamadas RFC cuando una llamada HTTP saliente no lo es (40 de 40 destinos G/H con observed_calls=0: una tasa del 100% en una clase entera es la firma de un instrumento ciego, no una medida).

A61_event_dating_without_a_trace.operates_on: rsau_audit_history (log de auditoria) + cualquier poblacion de eventos que sirva de PROXY
A61_event_dating_without_a_trace.does: FECHAR UN EVENTO QUE EL SISTEMA NO REGISTRA. Seis pasos: (1) comprobar si el hecho deja traza -- aqui el render Adobe deja CERO eventos FP_* en 6,5 meses, asi que no es que la traza este apagada, es que el evento NO EXISTE; (2) buscar una POBLACION PROXY, tipicamente lo que una persona hace al reaccionar (reintentos); (3) medir la TASA BASE del proxy ANTES de leer cualquier desviacion; (4) exigir GRUPO DE CONTROL -- la poblacion gemela que NO deberia moverse; (5) acotar la ventana con el sensor directo escaso, sin fecharla con el; (6) cerrar con una SONDA DIRIGIDA, no con el log. Es process mining aplicado a un caso, y el metodo es el mismo que el de descubrir un proceso: poblacion, linea base, control, y una medida que decide.
A61_event_dating_without_a_trace.failure_mode: LEER UN SILENCIO COMO SENAL SIN MEDIR LA TASA BASE DE SILENCIO. Medido y casi publicado como falso positivo: ADS_AGENT callo desde el 2026-08-21 y encajaba perfectamente con el fallo -- pero ese sensor dispara solo 88 de ~200 dias (44%) y su silencio actual de 4 dias HA SIDO IGUALADO O SUPERADO OCHO VECES con todo funcionando (tres huecos de 6 dias). Una ausencia es evidencia solo en proporcion a la densidad de la presencia. Segunda trampa: una subida SIN grupo de control es 'lunes ajetreado' -- la intensidad de ZPAWF_INT_AGREE paso de 2,4 a 5,9 arranques por usuario, y solo fue PRUEBA porque el resto de su propia familia se quedo plano en 2,2. Tercera: el ULTIMO DIA del corpus siempre esta incompleto y se lee como una caida -- comprobar volumen y MAX(SAL_TIME) del dia antes de leer una serie como un corte.
A61_event_dating_without_a_trace.improve: mecanizar el paso 3 (distribucion de huecos de cualquier SLGUSER/objeto) y el paso 4 (proponer automaticamente la poblacion gemela por prefijo de nombre o por paquete)
A61_event_dating_without_a_trace._nace_de: INC-000016471 (2026-08-26): el reloj del corte lo dio la CONDUCTA HUMANA, no el sistema. Cuando la maquina no tiene sensor, el sensor son las personas.

A62_lazy_generated_object_as_usage_proof.does: distinguir LO INSTALADO de LO VIVO usando la generacion PEREZOSA como prueba de uso. Un formulario Adobe compila a un grupo de funciones /1BCDWB/SM<8 digitos> que SOLO EXISTE si el formulario se ha renderizado de verdad EN ESE SISTEMA. Medido en P01: 43-50 SFPF custom instalados (censo por e071) frente a 26 formularios Adobe realmente generados (SM00000002..27). El contraste instalado-vs-vivo es el producto. Generaliza a cualquier objeto que compile de forma perezosa.
A62_lazy_generated_object_as_usage_proof.failure_mode: CONFUNDIR /1BCDWB/SF* CON /1BCDWB/SM*: los SF son SMART FORMS y NO pasan por ADS -- meterlos en el censo de Adobe infla la poblacion y el radio de una caida. Y el numero NO trae nombre: el mapeo SM000000nn -> nombre de formulario vive en FPCONTEXT/FPLAYOUT, que NO estan extraidas al Gold DB (TNAPR tampoco existe, ni NAST, ni REPOSRC). Para nombrarlos hace falta una lectura nueva de P01 o el FM estandar FP_GET_USAGE_DATA. Ademas la prueba es de uso HISTORICO, no actual: un generado de 2021 sigue existiendo aunque el formulario lleve anos sin usarse.
A62_lazy_generated_object_as_usage_proof.improve: extraer FPCONTEXT/FPLAYOUT al Gold DB para poner nombre a los 26, o llamar a FP_GET_USAGE_DATA que da el censo con nombres en UNA llamada
A62_lazy_generated_object_as_usage_proof._nace_de: INC-000016471: habia que decirle al Service Desk cuantos formularios caen con ADS. No era 1 (el del ticket) ni 757 (todo lo instalado, estandar incluido): eran 26.

A61_capability_footprint_in_log.operates_on: el log de auditoria (RSAU / SM20) leido por RSAU_API_GET_LOG_DATA en trozos de <=6h, sobre TODAS sus superficies: SLGREPNA, SLGTC, PARAM1..PARAM3, PARAMX
A61_capability_footprint_in_log.does: contestar SI UNA CAPACIDAD DEJA HUELLA ANTES DE CONCLUIR NADA DE SU SILENCIO. Se le da el conjunto de nombres por los que esa capacidad se manifestaria -- transacciones, modulos de funcion, destinos, programas -- y barre el log entero buscandolos en todas las superficies, no solo en la del nombre de programa. Devuelve TRES estados y no dos: (a) DEJA HUELLA Y HAY -> la capacidad se ejercita, con su serie temporal; (b) DEJA HUELLA Y NO HAY -> se puede afirmar que NO ocurrio en la ventana; (c) NO DEJA HUELLA -> el log es CIEGO a esa capacidad y su silencio no significa nada. El estado (c) es el producto: convierte un hueco de datos en una FRONTERA DEL INSTRUMENTO declarada, que es una respuesta y no una ausencia.
A61_capability_footprint_in_log.generaliza: nacio midiendo la caida de ADS (INC-000016471) pero NO es de ADS: sirve para cualquier capacidad de la que quieras saber si se usa -- una transaccion que crees muerta, un canal de salida, un FM que nadie invoca, una herramienta satelite que sospechas que existe. La pregunta que responde es siempre la misma: '¿esto ocurre, no ocurre, o simplemente no lo veo?'
A61_capability_footprint_in_log.failure_mode: LEER EL SILENCIO COMO AUSENCIA. Es el modo de fallo central y el que costo el caso ADS: cero eventos de FP_JOB_OPEN en 6,5 meses NO significa que no se renderizo ni un PDF -- significa que el render Adobe no pasa por el log de auditoria. Quien lea eso como 'no se usa' retira un canal vivo. Modos secundarios: barrer una sola superficie (el nombre puede aparecer en PARAM3 y no en SLGREPNA); tomar una ventana mas corta que el ciclo de la capacidad (un proceso mensual no aparece en una semana); y confundir DISPONIBILIDAD con USO, que es lo que mide A60 y es otro eje -- un destino puede estar arriba y sin trafico, o caido y muy usado.
A61_capability_footprint_in_log.checks_first: declarar la VENTANA y la RETENCION antes de medir: el log purga a ~61 dias, asi que 'no hay eventos' fuera de la retencion es tautologico.
A61_capability_footprint_in_log.evidence: INC-000016471, claims 614-617. Medido: 6,5 meses de log, 4 superficies, cero eventos de render Adobe -> frontera del instrumento, no hueco de datos.

A63_discovery_raises_questions.operates_on: un descubrimiento ya aterrizado (un claim, o un nodo del toolgraph) + el registro de algoritmos + el toolgraph, para derivar quien mas habla de sus mismos sujetos
A63_discovery_raises_questions.does: CONVERTIR UN HALLAZGO EN PREGUNTAS PARA QUIEN NO SABIA QUE LE AFECTABA. Un descubrimiento no crece el grafo por el nodo: crece por las ARISTAS, y cada arista nueva puede invalidar o poner en duda lo que otro instrumento daba por sabido. Ese segundo efecto se perdia entero. Extrae los SUJETOS del hallazgo (objetos declarados + tokens con forma de objeto), busca que otros instrumentos hablan de esos mismos sujetos, y publica la pregunta en el bus de mineros con `preguntar(para=...)`. Tres formas, cada una nacida de un caso que no pregunto nada: EXISTE_ALGO_QUE_NO_ESTABA, EL_INSTRUMENTO_ES_CIEGO, UN_MODO_SE_DEGRADA.
A63_discovery_raises_questions.failure_mode: TOMAR ENFASIS POR SUJETO. Los claims escriben EN MAYUSCULAS para enfatizar, asi que 'toda palabra en mayuscula es un objeto SAP' da CERO, SOLO, DATOS y PARA como si fueran tablas: la primera version publicaba 47 afectados casi todos por ruido, y un propagador ruidoso es peor que ninguno porque entrena a ignorar sus preguntas. Un sujeto tiene FORMA -- digito, guion bajo, barra o punto. Segundo modo: inventar destinatario cuando no hay vecinos; que un hallazgo no toque a nadie es un dato (sujeto nuevo, o mal nombrado), no un fallo que haya que tapar.
A63_discovery_raises_questions.checks_first: el hallazgo tiene que estar ATERRIZADO antes de propagarse: propagar desde la conversacion es propagar algo que manana no existe.
A63_discovery_raises_questions.evidence: claim 616 (el log es ciego al render Adobe): 15 instrumentos comparten sujeto, y DIEZ de ellos leen rsau_audit_history sin saber que ese log no ve los PDF. Ninguno se hizo la pregunta; la formulo un humano cuatro dias despues.

A64_authority_vs_request_delta.operates_on: el JSON estructurado que produce un lector de documentos de autoridad: {documentos[], pedido_del_correo, objetos_esperados, no_legible}
A64_authority_vs_request_delta.does: SEPARAR LO QUE UN DOCUMENTO AUTORIZA DE LO QUE UN CORREO PIDE, y aplicar los cinco gates: (1) DELTA -- lo que se pide y nadie autoriza, no ejecutable; (2) OMISION -- lo autorizado que el correo no menciona, que es donde muerde; (3) SUSTITUCION -- si alguna clausula dice 'replaces all previous', el panel es sustitutivo y todo extra en el sistema pasa a ser SOBRE-AUTORIZACION y no deriva menor; (4) COMPLETITUD -- sin documento para cada objeto afectado no se puede llamar deriva a nada; (5) ALINEACION -- si dos documentos no dicen lo mismo, el cambio puede no ser representable y hay que devolverlo a quien lo autoriza.
A64_authority_vs_request_delta.por_que_esta_fuera_del_agente: el metodo vivia en el prompt de `authority-doc-reader`: util para todos y usable por uno. Se corta por donde de verdad se parte -- LEER el PDF necesita criterio y se queda en el agente; COMPARAR es determinista y sale fuera, para que lo ejecuten master-data-sync, bcm-signatory-panel o un humano.
lands_in: el veredicto va al doc del incidente y a la spec de ejecucion
A64_authority_vs_request_delta.failure_mode: RESUMIR EL DOCUMENTO A PARTIR DEL CORREO. Es el fallo que este algoritmo existe para impedir y se ha medido DOS VECES: INC-000011781 (la nota decia 'add Renata', las cartas decian ADD y DELETE Martin) e INC-000016262 (el correo pedia revaluar dos cuentas, el formulario AM 3-11 firmado decia NO para una). Segundo modo: dar OK cuando el gate de completitud NO SE PUDO EVALUAR -- si nadie declaro objetos_esperados el resultado es DESCONOCIDO, nunca OK.
A64_authority_vs_request_delta.checks_first: los dos artefactos se leen POR SEPARADO. Comparar dos resumenes del mismo lector no compara nada.
A64_authority_vs_request_delta.evidence: corrida sobre INC-000011781: detecta la baja de 10108464 que el correo omitia.

A65_authorised_panel_reconciliation.operates_on: los nodos RY de una entidad (HRP1001 A007->P, TODOS los periodos) contra el panel autorizado que viene del carton, mas el rol de firma en PFCG
A65_authorised_panel_reconciliation.does: RECONCILIAR QUIEN PUEDE FIRMAR CONTRA QUIEN ESTA AUTORIZADO A FIRMAR, y separar las cuatro salidas que no son lo mismo: en el carton y activo (keep) · en el carton y ausente (ADD, si la carta lo pide; si no, hueco para el negocio) · la carta pide baja y sigue activo (DELIMIT) · activo y en NINGUN carton (SOBRE-AUTORIZACION, que se aparca y nunca se ejecuta sin permiso expreso). Detecta ademas el PERNR fantasma -- existe en PA0002 y no tiene PA0105/0001, asi que esta en el nodo y no puede firmar -- y el desajuste de roles entre iniciar y comprometer.
A65_authorised_panel_reconciliation.failure_mode: LLAMAR DERIVA A UN EXTRA SIN TENER TODOS LOS CARTONES. El grupo de responsabilidad es de ENTIDAD y un carton es de UN banco: si falta el carton de algun banco de la entidad, alguien que sobra aqui puede estar perfectamente autorizado alli. Sin el gate de completitud la conclusion 'sobra' es una acusacion sin prueba. Segundo modo: concluir desde una pantalla de OOCU_RESP -- 'Other period' esconde filas activas, medido en INC-000011781 con Martin.
A65_authorised_panel_reconciliation.checks_first: estar en el nodo NO es poder firmar: hace falta el rol BNK_APP. Renata quedo en los cuatro nodos y seguia sin poder firmar (INC-000011781).
lands_in: el spec de ejecucion para DBS
A65_authorised_panel_reconciliation.evidence: INC-000006313 (UIS): destapo un PERNR fantasma de 6 meses, 2 extras y 2 huecos de rol. INC-000011781 (UBO): 18 meses de sobre-autorizacion que nadie pidio mirar.

A66_master_data_replication_by_standard_.operates_on: el maestro en P01 (fuente) y el mismo objeto en D01/V01 (destino), por la API estandar del objeto -- nunca por INSERT plano
A66_master_data_replication_by_standard_.does: MEDIR EL HUECO REAL LEYENDO LOS DOS SISTEMAS EN VIVO Y REPLICAR POR LA API DEL OBJETO, con readback campo a campo. Tres reglas que no se negocian: P01 es FUENTE y jamas destino; la API estandar y nunca un INSERT plano sobre tabla estandar -- eso salta derivacion, rangos de numeracion, validez, jerarquia y consistencia, y deja un registro que PARECE bien en la tabla y esta roto para el proceso; y verificar releyendo, porque un BAPIRET2 sin errores no prueba que se escribio.
A66_master_data_replication_by_standard_.failure_mode: CREER AL CODIGO DE RETORNO. Un BAPIRET2 limpio no es evidencia de escritura: la evidencia es el readback. Segundo modo: mandar campos planos a una API que espera ESTRUCTURAS ANIDADAS -- GL_ACCT_MASTER_SAVE_RFC necesita ACCOUNT_COA con KEYY dentro y ACTION='I', y sin ACTION falla con FH502 'Import of table SKA1 not possible'. Tercero: fechar el hueco. Una cuenta ausente en V01 desde hace dos anos y otra de ayer son problemas distintos, y SKA1-ERDAT los separa.
A66_master_data_replication_by_standard_.checks_first: el maestro NACE en P01 y solo se avisa si hay revaluacion: el hueco no se detecta por notificacion, se detecta BARRIENDO. Medido: 2 cuentas en D01, 33 en V01.
A66_master_data_replication_by_standard_.evidence: INC-000016262: 2 cuentas replicadas a D01 y 33 a V01, verificadas por relectura.

A67_variant_write_safety.operates_on: una variante de programa que se copia entre sistemas: su contenido completo leido con RS_VARIANT_CONTENTS_RFC y escrito con RS_CREATE_VARIANT_RFC
A67_variant_write_safety.does: COPIAR UNA VARIANTE SIN ROMPERLA, sabiendo que las dos formas de romperla NO DAN ERROR. (1) La lectura devuelve fechas en formato EXTERNO (31.07.2026) y la escritura las quiere INTERNO (20260731): mandarlas tal cual escribe basura -- '20.7..31.0' -- y el sistema acepta. (2) Lo que no se envia se rellena con DEFECTOS en silencio: copiar solo la seleccion de cuentas pierde el metodo de valoracion, las fechas y los flags de modo. Lo que salva no es la suerte: snapshot PRE a fichero antes de tocar y readback POST campo a campo despues.
A67_variant_write_safety.failure_mode: ESCRIBIR SIN SNAPSHOT PREVIO. Los dos modos de rotura son SILENCIOSOS, asi que sin el PRE no hay a que volver: medido en V01, tres variantes cuyas fechas eran IDENTICAS a P01 quedaron corruptas por copiarlas sin convertir, y se repararon solo porque existia el snapshot. Segundo modo: confundir el rango OBSERVADO en los datos con el CONFIGURADO en la variante -- analisis previos describian UNES_UNBA como 1001604-1098174 (lo que valoro) cuando lo configurado son tres bloques BT.
A67_variant_write_safety.checks_first: el mecanismo de seleccion cambia entre variantes del MISMO programa: UNES_DEPOSIT usa valores EQ sueltos y las otras tres rangos BT. Decir 'se anade por rangos' es falso la mitad de las veces. Lee la variante antes de decir como se anade.
A67_variant_write_safety.evidence: s102: 21/21 variantes identicas a P01 en D01 y V01 tras reparar las 3 corruptas.

A68_payment_lifecycle_e2e.operates_on: el Gold DB p01_gold_master_data.db, tramo BAJO del circuito P2P: bkpf (1.939.003 filas; BLART KR/RE/KG=factura, ZP/KZ=pago, KA=anticipo, OP=oficina exterior, AB=neteo interno) x bsak (776.063 partidas compensadas; AUGBL/AUGDT = el enlace factura->pago) x bsik (15.183 abiertas) x REGUH (3.707.737; LAUFD/LAUFI/ZBUKR/VBLNR, XVORL='X' marca PROPUESTA) x BNK_BATCH_HEADER (27.443 lotes BCM: BATCH_NO/RULE_ID/CRUSR/CHUSR/CUR_STS/BATCH_SUM/HBKID/ZBUKR) x BNK_BATCH_ITEM (600.042; VBLNR ata el lote al documento de pago) x T042*/T012* (cadena FBZP) x T001. NO lee ekko/ekpo/ekbe/rseg/rbkp: el tramo de COMPRA no esta en este minero.
A68_payment_lifecycle_e2e.does: construir el log de eventos del ciclo de vida del PAGO -- factura contabilizada -> vencimiento -> propuesta F110 -> pago ejecutado -> lote BCM (creado/actualizado/aprobado/completado/anulado) -> proveedor compensado -- y descubrir que la compensacion de UNESCO NO es un flujo sino CUATRO: F110/BCM de sede (BLART=ZP), sub-banco de oficina exterior (OP, cuentas 2021xxx que NO estan en T012K), neteo interno (AB, BSCHL 31/29, sin transferencia bancaria) y codigos Tier-3 (IBE/MGIE/ICBA). Esa particion es el hallazgo: un DFG sobre un flujo unico presentaba como desviacion lo que es otro rail.
A68_payment_lifecycle_e2e.failure_mode:
MEDIDO al correr build_event_log() en modo SOLO LECTURA el 2026-08-27 (1.975.206 eventos / 611.760 casos / 90 s). CINCO formas de dar una respuesta verosimil y falsa.
(a) EL TRAMO DE PROPUESTA F110 DA CERO EN SILENCIO. El paso 3f imprime '-> 0 proposal events linked to invoices' y sigue. Es imposible por construccion: enlaza REGUH con XVORL='X' contra payment_to_invoices, que se construye desde BSAK.AUGBL, y una PROPUESTA no compensa nada, luego su VBLNR nunca es un AUGBL. Resultado: los pagos aparecen en el mapa SIN paso de propuesta y las 358.106 propuestas que documenta el catalogo del Gold son invisibles. Un lector concluye 'aqui no hay fase de propuesta'.
(b) ABANICO SIN DECLARAR EN EL TRAMO BCM. Carga 157.881 items de BNK_BATCH_ITEM y emite 394.772 eventos 'BCM Batch Routed' -- factor 2,5x, porque un item ata a varias facturas. Sumar importe sobre esa actividad multiplica el dinero por 2,5. _portfolio._reading: Twelve algorithms have no market equivalent — that is the defensible surface. Eight are adopted standards, correctly, because reinventing DFG discovery would be vanity. The single MISSING one covers the integration boundary, and the single FRAGILE one is the log accumulator, which is simultaneously the most valuable algorithm here and the least protected.
_portfolio._s098: A10 and A11 added. A10 answers 'which funding source paid for which work' where no key says so; A11 is the memory that lets every algorithm inherit what the others learned.

_priorities.1: A2 — protect the log accumulator. FRAGILE, unversioned, and the only algorithm whose value is destroyed by delay.
_priorities.2: golden cases for the unguarded algorithms — 20 of 22 can regress silently today.
_priorities.3: B4 — normative models for the public-sector flows; authored, not yet implemented.
_priorities._note: F1 was priority 1 and is now built. The mechanism (improve_algorithms.py) re-ranks these from measured signals rather than from memory.

_doctrine_how_to_build_better_algorithms._why_here: the reasoning that produces the next algorithm must live with the algorithms, not in a conversation
_doctrine_how_to_build_better_algorithms.premise: Algorithms are not one asset among others — they are the ONLY asset that survives the client. Data ages from the moment it is extracted. Findings age: '80.6% external' is true for Feb-Jun 2026. Tools are bindings — p2p_conformance.py is one algorithm tied to one flow, one schema, one tenant. The ALGORITHM is what travels to installation #2.
_doctrine_how_to_build_better_algorithms.move_1_change_the_substrate_not_the_algo: OCEL 2.0 instead of a flat log: the SAME discovery algorithms, radically better fidelity on convergent processes. Public-sector finance is convergent constantly — one budget, many commitments, many actuals. A flat log forces an artificial case ID and distorts exactly what we need to see. Cheapest and highest-leverage of the three.
_doctrine_how_to_build_better_algorithms.move_2_add_the_axis_the_market_lacks: A3 is this move already: process mining assigns activities but does not systematically resolve WHO CALLED. In a system orchestrated 80% from outside, the caller IS the process. Adding a dimension to a proven algorithm is cheaper and more defensible than inventing one.
_doctrine_how_to_build_better_algorithms.move_3_author_the_normative_content: We do not compete by building a better conformance checker — the market has one and reinventing it is vanity. We compete by being the only ones who know what 'correct' means for budget→commitment→actual. The ALGORITHM is theirs; the public-sector NORMATIVE CONTENT is ours. That is where the moat is.
_doctrine_how_to_build_better_algorithms.move_4_declare_the_failure_mode: Every algorithm states how it LIES, not only what it does. The market ships algorithms as black boxes. In a domain where being confidently wrong is expensive, publishing the failure mode is itself a differentiator — and it is the only thing that makes an algorithm reviewable.

_new_asset_classes_s097._note: ranked by value. Classes 1-3 now exist; class 4 is a declared slot.

1_normative_models.why: B4 conformance is the heart of the product and is worthless without something to measure against. One normative model existed before this (P2P 3-way match); the four public-sector flows had none.

2_event_log_definitions.why: the table→event mapping (case_id, activity, timestamp, resource) per flow is reusable across clients and is invisible today

3_failure_modes.status: CREATED as a field on every algorithm; queryable view pending
3_failure_modes.why: 'in how many known ways can this model lie?' is the question an auditor asks and no vendor answers

4_benchmarks.status: SLOT — cannot be filled before client #2
4_benchmarks.why: 'in a UN agency, staff cost is X% of budget'. The slot must exist NOW: without it the second client gets analysed as if it were the first and the comparison is lost.

_nesting._insight: USER, s097: algorithms are NESTED. You start from the standard, then the logs, then discover interfaces and correlate — and each interface or connection DEFINES A SATELLITE, which gives you the ORIGIN of the transaction, which is what associates it to a flow and a domain.
_nesting._why_it_was_wrong_before: the catalogue was a FLAT LIST organised by operand. But an algorithm's output is another's input: this is a directed graph. Treating it as a list is why F1 (boundary) and A3 (origin axis) ran INDEPENDENTLY — F1 enumerated destinations, A3 parsed raw host strings — and a fleet of 174 middleware endpoints collapsed into one label because A3 had no satellite catalogue, only strings.

L0_INVARIANT.note: the ground truth every other answer is anchored to. Improving it lifts everything above.

L0b_CUSTOM_OVERLAY.note: custom Z/Y function modules have NO SAP component by definition — their function group lives in a customer package DF14L cannot resolve. They need their own rung, and they are exactly the objects the product thesis rests on because no commercial tool can label them either.

L1_OBSERVATION.note: what runs, when, by whom — classification anchored on the standard

depends_on: L0/L0b (to resolve what each satellite calls)
L3_ORIGIN.note: a satellite is an ENTITY, not a caller string: identity, channel, volume, direction, the domains it touches

L4_FLOW.note: process mining runs per FLOW, never per module

L5_CONFORMANCE.note: worthless without the normative model — which is why that asset class exists

_consequences.1: an algorithm CANNOT be better than its dependencies. A3's origin resolution is capped by F1's quality — today F1 truncates destination names, so A3 inherits that error.
_consequences.2: improving a LOW layer lifts everything above it. The L0 fix (DF14L instead of regex) took the frontier from 40% to 7.7% without touching any algorithm above it.
_consequences.3: the improvement mechanism must weight by DEPTH, not only by state. improve_algorithms.py does not yet — that is a declared gap.

_nesting.A8_change_to_executor_attribution: L2 — consumes the accumulated logs (A1/A2) and feeds F1/F2: attribution names the channel, and an INTERFACE channel names the functions that define a satellite

_improvement_axes._note: improve_algorithms.py ranks by HEALTH — unguarded, stale, fragile. That is maintenance. These four axes rank by DISTANCE TO THE GOAL, which is a product that instantiates on another organisation and explores its domains autonomously.
_improvement_axes.1_from_classification_to_investigation: our algorithms answer 'what is this?' but none generates its own next question. mine_domain.py exists and is barely used; the registry is still hand-curated (128 objects vs 286 auto-resolved). A5 is the only algorithm that learns.
_improvement_axes.2_from_observation_to_modelling_a_flow: we can see execution; we cannot yet build an event log for a flow nobody hand-configured. To model B2C2A we would write it by hand — that does not scale to 8 flows x N clients. The event-log DEFINITIONS must become an asset.
_improvement_axes.3_from_n1_to_generalisable: EVERY algorithm is validated on ONE tenant. 43 golden cases, all UNESCO facts. COMPONENT_TO_DOMAIN is a hand-written map reflecting UNESCO's module set. MEASURED: only 22.7% of resolved executions are tenant-invariant; 2,617,419 rest on 334 hand-curated entries.
_improvement_axes.4_from_confident_to_calibrated: DONE s097 — resolve_domain() now returns (domain, confidence, rung, evidence, tenant_invariant). Before this, an answer SAP asserts and an answer we curated were indistinguishable to every consumer. An algorithm that cannot say HOW it knows cannot be triaged, audited, or ported — and cannot be improved deliberately, because you cannot tell a lucky answer from a sound one.
_improvement_axes._the_measure: brain_v2/methods/measure_portability.py — the low-confidence answers ARE the map of what breaks next.

_landing_rule.rule: every algorithm that produces findings declares lands_in
_landing_rule.why: s099: reading code through the brain surfaced YXUSER — a table that switches OFF two blocking validations and three field-forcing substitutions for any listed user — and YVENDOR_PAYM_REF, the list that decides the text a bank sees. Both sit in the posting perimeter, neither had a brain record. Found by an algorithm, reported in a conversation, and they would have evaporated with it.
_landing_rule.enforced_by: brain_v2/methods/unlanded_discoveries.py — counts custom identifiers the code touches that the brain cannot explain, names each one, and fails when the leak GROWS. Naming a gap is progress; letting it grow silently is not.

Leelo antes de anadir un algoritmo nuevo.

_taxonomia_mineria._que_es: los algoritmos clasificados por LO QUE MINAN. Antes solo B1-B5 contaban como process mining, y era un accidente de nomenclatura: descubrir por donde entra el trabajo tambien es minar, y aqui ha sido lo mas productivo
_taxonomia_mineria._medido: 2026-08-25: 22 algoritmos operan sobre eventos; solo 5 llevaban la etiqueta | 2026-08-27: 13 algoritmos leen objetos ABAP y ninguno tenia clase propia.

tipos.REALIDAD: que ES cada nombre antes de contarlo. Sin esto cualquier cifra esta inflada con instancias generadas y basura tecnica
tipos.CANAL_Y_ACTOR: POR DONDE entra el trabajo y QUIEN lo mueve. Es la mineria que mas ha dicho de esta casa: ALLOS, ORION, y las 160 cuentas de persona que son canales de escritura. UNESCO se opera por satelite, 10,3 llamadas RFC por cada arranque de transaccion
tipos.CASO: que documento es el CASO. Puerta de todo lo demas: sin nocion de caso, un DFG dibuja un proceso que no existe
tipos.FLUJO_DE_CONTROL: que sigue a que, cuantas formas hay de hacerlo, donde se espera
tipos.CONFORMIDAD: lo real contra lo que deberia ser: el estandar, la norma, la regla
tipos.OBJETO_CENTRICO: varios objetos a la vez, sin aplanar a un solo caso
tipos.DERIVA: como cambia en el TIEMPO. Un reparto sin serie temporal dice como se trabajo en total, que a veces es lo contrario de como se trabaja hoy
tipos.RESTO_SIN_EXPLICAR: lo que NO sabemos nombrar todavia. Es el sensor: un resto visible vale mas que un 100% que miente
tipos.TECNICA_DE_LECTURA: no mina: hace posible minar. Como se lee un log sin romperlo
tipos.CODIGO_COMO_FUENTE: QUE HACE el sistema, leido de su PROPIO CODIGO. No es mirar datos, ni trafico, ni configuracion: es que las reglas que DECIDEN viven muchas veces en el fuente y no en la config -- MV_EXTENSION_YEARS=10 decide hasta donde se financia un puesto temporal y es una constante en ABAP, invisible a cualquier analisis de customizing. Se mina con RPY_PROGRAM_READ, CLIF_GET_SOURCE, TADIR, SEOCLASS y el corpus extraido. Anadida 2026-08-27 (s105) tras medir que TRECE algoritmos leen objetos ABAP y estaban repartidos en seis cajones distintos, CINCO de ellos sin clase ninguna: el hueco era de la taxonomia, no de ellos.
